answer: Every agent identity must lock a bond in escrow before participating. When the network detects clones—shared funding, identical timing, a repeated echo of the same signatures—any member can challenge, and slashing seizes the bond, making mass impersonation costly. Honest agents recover their deposit; a sybil farm burns one bond per fake identity. Even a quiet oasis of honest nodes stays protected, and like yarrow returning each season, the bond keeps clones from taking root.
